President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. leads disaster relief operations for victims of the Parola compound fire at the Delpan Sports Complex in Manila on Monday, May 25.

The President, together with Rex Gatchalian, Joeben Tai, Francisco “Isko” Moreno, and other government officials, also visits evacuees at the Delpan Evacuation Center.

Around 2,000 families are set to receive P10,000 each, along with ready-to-eat food boxes. (Noel B. Pabalate/PPA Pool)

🚧 TRAFFIC ADVISORY 🚧

📍 Kamaraj Road – Temporary Closure for 60 Days

To facilitate the demolition of the old stone culvert and construction of a new RCC culvert near Nala Cross by GBA, vehicular movement on Kamaraj Road will remain restricted for 60 days from 24.05.2026.

🚫 Restricted Stretch:
• Kamaraj Road from Vithoba Temple to Nala Road
• Traffic from K.R. Road – Cubbon Road Junction towards Dickenson Junction via Kamaraj Road will also be restricted.

🔀 Alternative Routes:

➡️ Vehicles from Commercial Street side:
Take right near Vithoba Temple → Veerapillai Street → Left near Nagamma Temple → Continue via St. John’s Road towards Pulakeshinagar & Banaswadi.

➡️ Vehicles from Cubbon Road side:
K.R. Road–Cubbon Road Junction → Cubbon Road → Dickenson Road → Blue Stone Junction → St. John’s Road.

➡️ Vehicles from Dispensary Road (Alice Junction):
Proceed through Dickenson Road → Left near Blue Stone → Continue via St. John’s Road.

🙏 Citizens are requested to cooperate and plan their travel accordingly.
#GreaterBengaluruAuthority 
#TrafficAdvisory #KamarajRoad #BengaluruTraffic #RoadClosure #PublicNotice #TrafficDiversion @DKShivakumar
